title: Determine Whether Two Binary Search Trees Contain the Same Set of Keys
problemStatement: Given the roots of two Binary Search Trees, determine whether both trees contain exactly the same set of keys, regardless of their structures.
input: • The first line contains N₁. • The next N₁ lines describe the first BST. • The following line contains N₂. • The next N₂ lines describe the second BST.
output: • Print YES if both trees contain the same keys; otherwise print NO.
